name_zh: 安斯麦/比利时/因贝夫/百威/全球啤酒/并购/3G资本/巴西/比利时
description_zh: 因贝夫 (InBev) 比利时啤酒巨头，若热·保罗·莱曼 (Jorge Paulo Lemann) 3G资本零基预算/成本控制/人才密度模式，并购安海斯-布希 (百威) 打造全球最大啤酒帝国，比利时小国企业通过零基预算/人才密度/全球并购模式实现全球霸权，百威/科罗娜/斯泰拉品牌全球统治。
description_en: InBev Belgian beer giant, Jorge Paulo Lemann 3G Capital zero-based budgeting/cost control/talent density model, acquired Anheuser-Busch (Budweiser) building global largest beer empire, Belgian small nation enterprise achieved global hegemony through zero-based budgeting/talent density/global M&A model, Budweiser/Corona/Stella brands global domination.
reason_zh: 安斯麦代表小国企业如何通过激进并购与极致成本控制实现全球行业霸权，展示了零基预算/3G资本模式如何重塑传统消费品行业，其比利时小国企业通过全球并购实现全球啤酒霸权的商业奇迹。
reason_en: AB InBev represents how small nation enterprise achieves global industry hegemony through aggressive M&A and extreme cost control, demonstrating how zero-based budgeting/3G Capital model reshapes traditional consumer goods industry, its Belgian small nation enterprise achieving global beer hegemony through global M&A commercial miracle.

分析零基预算/人才密度/成本控制/梦想/文化/3G模式

评估百威/科罗娜/斯泰拉全球品牌/巴西/比利时/墨西哥/中国布局
总结全球啤酒/并购整合/3G资本/零基预算/比利时全球化五重遗产
steps_en: Study AB InBev early Belgium/Interbrew/Stella/Brazil 3G Capital
Analyze zero-based budgeting/talent density/cost control/dream/culture/3G model
Summarize global beer/M&A integration/3G Capital/zero-based budgeting/Belgian globalization quintuple legacy
expected_zh: 掌握零基预算如何重塑传统消费品成本结构，理解并购整合如何实现全球品牌组合协同，评估因贝夫比利时小国企业全球啤酒霸权的商业奇迹与反垄断挑战。
expected_en: Master how zero-based budgeting reshapes traditional consumer goods cost structure, grasp how M&A integration achieves global brand portfolio synergy, evaluate AB InBev Belgian small nation enterprise global beer hegemony commercial miracle and antitrust challenges.
case_zh: 2004 英特布鲁/安海斯合并；2008 百威收购；2016 桑布鲁米勒收购。全球啤酒/并购/3G资本/零基预算/比利时范式永存。
case_en: 2004 Interbrew/AmBev merger; 2008 Budweiser acquisition; 2016 SABMiller acquisition. Global beer/M&A/3G Capital/zero-based budgeting/Belgian paradigm endures.
